meta.title: QC Hold on GRN Pending Inspection: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Sign in as a Quality Inspector on the Growth-plan tenant and verify that QC Hold on GRN Pending Inspection is absent or refused.
Use QC Hold on GRN Pending Inspection to automatically hold QC-mandatory GRNs.
Repeat the same QC Hold workflow on an Enterprise-plan tenant and verify that it is available and works.
Compare the same user's capability across Growth and Enterprise plans.
Observe or change the tenant plan entitlement required for this capability.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a Quality Inspector on the Growth-plan tenant and verify that QC Hold on GRN Pending Inspection is absent or refused.; Use QC Hold on GRN Pending Inspection to automatically hold QC-mandatory GRNs.; Repeat the same QC Hold workflow on an Enterprise-plan tenant and verify that it is available and works.; Compare the same user's capability across Growth and Enterprise plans.; Observe or change the tenant plan entitlement required for this capability.

args.need: sign in as the same Quality Inspector on the Growth and Enterprise tenants, try QC Hold on GRN Pending Inspection on both, and report whether the capability is absent or refused on Growth and works on Enterprise

steps.note: The catalog cannot access the Quality Inspector identity, GRN/QC screens, or plan-gated capability.
Assert that the resulting screen is free of crashes or raw errors after the tester's workflow; this does not assert the QC Hold behavior.
